'''T-12''' was a tunnel that was a part of an [[Morak Imperial refinery|Imperial refinery]] on [[Morak]]. [[Juggernaut Five]] was cleared to enter the tunnel before it was assaulted by [[Din Djarin]] and his allies.<ref name="Chapter15" />
